title: India vs Bhutan Ends In A Thrilling Win For The Blue Tigers In SAFF Semi-Finals

 India won 2-1 against their neighbours today. The exciting India vs. Bhutan match sends the Blue Tigers to the SAFF Championship final against Pakistan.
 by Sportscape Editor | Nov 16, 2026 | 2 mins read India vs Bhutan Ends In A Thrilling Win For The Blue Tigers In SAFF Semi-Finals · Credits: Via X Football The highly anticipated India vs Bhutan football match concluded with a narrow victory for the national team today. The squad managed to survive a late comeback attempt to secure their spot in the next round of the regional tournament.
 This crucial SAFF Championship semi-final took place at the National Stadium in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Fans watched closely as India won 2-1 after ninety minutes of competitive football. The Blue Tigers controlled the majority of the first half before facing heavier defensive pressure late in the game.
 Early Goals From Vishnu PV And The Captain
 The national team started the match with an excellent attacking rhythm. Vishnu PV opened the scoring in the ninth minute of the game. He received a long diagonal pass, beat a defender with his first touch, and placed the ball perfectly into the bottom corner.
 The team continued to create chances and quickly doubled their advantage before the half-hour mark. During a corner kick in the 27th minute, captain Chinglensana Singh Konsham reacted fastest to a loose ball in the penalty box. He smashed the ball into the net to give his team a comfortable two-goal lead heading into halftime.
 Bhutan Fights Back In The Second Half
 Despite the early setback, Bhutan refused to give up and came out attacking in the second period. They found the back of the net in the 48th minute through a strike from Kinzang Tashi Tobden. The Video Assistant Referee reviewed the play and overturned an initial offside flag to correctly award the goal.
 This unexpected goal completely shifted the momentum of the match. The opposing forwards created several dangerous chances, forcing the Indian goalkeeper to make important saves to protect the lead. However, the defensive line stayed organised and successfully held off the pressure until the final whistle.
 Preparing For The India vs Pakistan Final
 With this hard-fought victory, we will officially see India in the final of the regional tournament once again. The young squad is now fully focused on recovering their fitness before the biggest match of their international careers.
 The upcoming India vs Pakistan final is scheduled for Tuesday, November 17. The team is actively fighting for the 10th title in the history of the competition. Winning this historic trophy against their biggest rivals would prove that the future of Indian football is moving in a very positive direction.
